theme: Unexpected Destinations That Became Client Favorites

linkedin.text:
We've produced events in 130+ destinations. The ones clients ask to repeat are rarely the obvious choices.

Paris, Dubai, Barcelona — all stunning. But some of the highest-rated programs we've delivered were in places that weren't on the client's radar until we put them on the table.

Here's what we've observed across 1,500+ events: unfamiliarity creates presence. When participants don't already have a mental map of a place, they actually show up — curious, engaged, off their phones.

That's not a soft feeling. It shows up in post-event survey scores and in whether the leadership team calls you six months later to start planning the next one.

If you're scoping destinations for a conference, incentive trip or executive retreat and want an honest read on what's performing well right now — DM me. No pitch, just a 15-minute conversation.

facebook.text:
Some of our most-requested repeat destinations weren't on anyone's original shortlist.

A coastal town nobody had heard of. A mountain village that didn't seem 'corporate' enough. A city everyone assumed was too complicated to pull off.

Then the event happened — and the client asked to go back before the flight home.

After 1,500+ events across 130+ destinations, we've learned that the places that surprise your team are the ones they never stop talking about.

Planning something for later this year? Drop a comment or send us a message — happy to share what's been landing well lately.
